<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>

<script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"ProfessionalService","name":"I&I BIM Engineering Consultant","description":"BIM management, engineering coordination, interior design and fit-out documentation, shop drawings and 3D visualization.","address":{"@type":"PostalAddress","addressLocality":"Kochi","addressRegion":"Kerala","addressCountry":"IN"},"telephone":["+91 95260 04440","+91 80896 60777"],"founder":{"@type":"Person","name":"Wilson Louis"},"areaServed":["India","Qatar","Saudi Arabia","Belgium","United States"]}</script>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,500;0,600;1,500&family=Cinzel:wght@500;600&family=Pinyon+Script&family=Jost:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* VOICE occasion: a private-client luxury studio, black and gold, matching the new gold logo
   IDEA a jewellery-house window: black velvet ground, gold hairlines, objects lit one at a time
   PICTURE full-bleed material study in the hero, then a gold-line LOD ladder and lit photo panels
   COLOUR black #070605, panel #13110e, logo gold #dcb468, cream text #15130f
   TYPE Cormorant Garamond headlines, Cinzel for the logo-style name, Jost text
   LAYOUT laptop: photo hero with headline panel bottom-left; phone: photo, headline, buttons, stats */
:root{color-scheme:light;--bg:#f7f5f1;--panel:#ffffff;--panel2:#efebe4;--gold:#9a7432;--gold2:#7a5a22;--ink:#15130f;--mute:#5e584f;--line:rgba(21,19,15,.14);--line2:rgba(21,19,15,.08)}
*{box-sizing:border-box;min-width:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:80px}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:400 16px/1.7 Jost,system-ui,sans-serif;overflow-x:clip}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:"Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif;font-weight:500;line-height:1.02;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.01em;text-wrap:balance}
h2{font-size:clamp(38px,4.6vw,64px)}
h3{font-size:26px;line-height:1.15}
p{margin:0}
a{color:inherit}
img{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
em{font-style:italic;color:var(--gold)}
.band{padding-block:clamp(56px,8vw,128px);padding-left:max(5vw,16px);padding-right:max(5vw,16px)}
.wrap{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto}
.kick{font-family:Cinzel,serif;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:16px}
.lead{font-size:18px;font-weight:300;color:var(--mute);max-width:58ch}
.rule{height:1px;background:var(--line);border:0;margin:0}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;min-height:52px;padding:0 28px;background:var(--gold);color:#ffffff;font:600 15px Jost,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.04em;text-decoration:none;border:1px solid var(--gold);cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;transition:background .2s}
.btn:hover{background:#f3d48e}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--gold)}
.btn.ghost:hover{background:rgba(232,193,114,.1)}
.btn svg{width:18px;height:18px}
a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:3px}
.head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:20px 72px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:52px}
.cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px}
.blend{mix-blend-mode:screen}
/* header */
header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5;background:rgba(7,6,5,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:24px;max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;padding:10px max(5vw,16px)}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;text-decoration:none}
.brand img{height:58px;width:auto}
.brand span{font-family:Cinzel,serif;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--gold);line-height:1.3;white-space:nowrap}
.brand small{display:block;font-family:Jost,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.06em;font-size:11px;color:var(--mute)}
.links{display:flex;gap:4px;margin-left:auto}
.links a{text-decoration:none;padding:10px 12px;color:var(--mute);font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.03em;white-space:nowrap}
.links a:hover{color:var(--gold)}
.nav .btn{min-height:44px;padding:0 18px}
/* hero */
.hero{position:relative;min-height:min(calc(100svh - 108px),900px);display:grid;place-items:center;padding:clamp(48px,6vw,80px) max(5vw,16px);overflow:hidden;text-align:center}
.slides{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;background:#000}
.slide{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 45%;opacity:0;transform:scale(1.08);transition:opacity 1.8s ease}
.slide.on{opacity:1;animation:kbA 9s ease-out forwards}
.slide.kbB.on{animation-name:kbB}.slide.kbC.on{animation-name:kbC}.slide.kbD.on{animation-name:kbD}
@keyframes kbA{from{transform:scale(1.16)}to{transform:scale(1.03)}}
@keyframes kbB{from{transform:scale(1.12) translateX(-2.5%)}to{transform:scale(1.12) translateX(2.5%)}}
@keyframes kbC{from{transform:scale(1.03)}to{transform:scale(1.15)}}
@keyframes kbD{from{transform:scale(1.12) translate(2%,2%)}to{transform:scale(1.12) translate(-2%,-1%)}}
.lw{position:relative;width:min(760px,88vw)}
.lw .hlogo{width:100%;display:block}
.dots{position:absolute;z-index:3;left:50%;bottom:26px;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;gap:6px}
.dots button{width:44px;height:44px;border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0}
.dots button::after{content:"";width:28px;height:2px;background:rgba(239,230,214,.4);transition:background .4s,width .4s}
.dots button[aria-pressed=true]::after{background:var(--gold);width:40px}
.hc>h1{animation:rise 1.2s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) .3s both}
.hc>.lw,.hc>.lw .hlogo{animation:none!important;transform:none}
@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.slide{transition:none}.slide.on{animation:none;transform:scale(1.02)}.hc>*{animation:none}}
.hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 55% at 50% 48%,rgba(5,4,3,.78),rgba(5,4,3,.5) 60%,rgba(5,4,3,.72));pointer-events:none}
.hc{position:relative;z-index:2;display:grid;justify-items:center;gap:22px;max-width:900px}
.hlogo{width:min(760px,88vw);height:auto;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.6))}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(40px,5vw,74px);line-height:1.05;text-shadow:0 2px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
.script{font-family:"Pinyon Script",cursive;font-weight:400;color:var(--gold);font-size:1.32em;line-height:.8;letter-spacing:0;padding:0 .06em}
.introb{text-align:center;padding-block:clamp(40px,5vw,72px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.introb .lead{margin:0 auto;max-width:60ch;font-size:clamp(18px,1.6vw,22px);color:#4a443b}
.introb .cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:14px;margin-top:28px}
.introb .btn{min-width:240px}
.leaders{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:16px;margin-top:18px}
.founder{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;text-decoration:none;background:rgba(7,6,5,.72);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:10px 20px 10px 10px;border-radius:999px;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);text-align:left}
.founder img{width:76px;height:76px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--gold)}
.founder b{display:block;font:500 26px/1.1 "Cormorant Garamond",serif;color:var(--ink)}
.founder small{display:block;font-size:14px;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.02em}
.founder:hover b{color:var(--gold)}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.stats div{padding:28px 24px;border-left:1px solid var(--line)}
.stats div:first-child{border-left:0;padding-left:0}
.stats b{display:block;font:500 clamp(40px,4vw,58px)/1 "Cormorant Garamond",serif;color:var(--gold)}
.stats span{font-size:14px;color:var(--mute)}
/* intro */
.intro{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(32px,6vw,96px);align-items:center}
.intro .q{font:italic 500 clamp(30px,3.4vw,48px)/1.15 "Cormorant Garamond",serif}
.intro .q b{color:var(--gold);font-weight:500}
.frame{position:relative;padding:14px;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.frame img{width:100%;height:560px;object-fit:cover}
.frame figcaption{font-size:13px;color:var(--mute);margin-top:12px}
/* interiors feature */
.feat{background:var(--panel);display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.05fr) minmax(0,1fr)}
.feat img{width:100%;height:100%;min-height:560px;object-fit:cover}
.feat .txt{padding:clamp(36px,5vw,80px);display:grid;gap:22px;align-content:center}
.ticks{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px 28px}
.ticks li{position:relative;padding-left:22px;font-size:15px;color:#3d3830;line-height:1.5}
.ticks li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:.6em;width:9px;height:9px;transform:rotate(45deg);border:1px solid var(--gold)}
/* services */
.sgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:1px;background:var(--line);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.svc{background:var(--bg);padding:clamp(26px,3vw,40px);display:grid;gap:16px;align-content:start}
.svc .top{display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:baseline}
.svc .n{font:italic 500 24px "Cormorant Garamond",serif;color:var(--gold);flex:none;width:34px}
.svc h3{font-size:clamp(26px,2.4vw,32px)}
.svc .ticks{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
/* gallery */
.gal{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.4fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.gal img{width:100%;height:540px;object-fit:cover}
.gnote{font-size:13px;color:var(--mute);margin-top:16px}
/* lod */
.lodb{background:var(--panel)}
.lod{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));gap:1px;background:var(--line);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.lv{background:var(--panel);padding:20px;display:grid;gap:8px;align-content:start}
.lv svg{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3}
.lv b{font:500 30px/1 "Cormorant Garamond",serif;color:var(--gold)}
.lv h3{font-family:Jost,sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:500}
.lv p{font-size:14px;color:var(--mute);line-height:1.5}
.lv .use{color:#3d3830;border-top:1px solid var(--line2);padding-top:10px;font-size:13px}
.lg{fill:none;stroke:var(--gold);stroke-width:1.6}.lf{fill:var(--gold)}.lm{fill:rgba(232,193,114,.14);stroke:var(--gold);stroke-width:1.2;stroke-dasharray:4 4}.lb{fill:var(--panel)}
.ld{fill:none;stroke:#15130f;stroke-width:1.4;stroke-dasharray:4 3;opacity:.7}.lt{fill:none;stroke:#15130f;stroke-width:1;opacity:.5}
.lc{fill:none;stroke:var(--gold);stroke-width:3.5;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
/* projects */
.pg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:22px}
.pcard{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;transition:border-color .4s}
.pcard:hover{border-color:rgba(154,116,50,.6)}
.pcard.wide{grid-column:1/-1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.35fr) minmax(0,1fr)}
.pimg{margin:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:16/10;background:#f3f0ea}
.pcard.wide .pimg{aspect-ratio:auto;min-height:420px}
.pimg img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 1.2s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.pimg.contain img{object-fit:contain;padding:18px}
.pimg.duo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2px;background:var(--bg)}
.pimg.duo img{position:relative;height:100%}
.pcard:hover .pimg img{transform:scale(1.05)}
.pbody{position:relative;padding:clamp(24px,3vw,40px);display:grid;gap:12px;align-content:start}
.pcard.wide .pbody{align-content:center}
.pn{position:absolute;right:clamp(20px,3vw,36px);top:clamp(18px,2.6vw,30px);font:500 44px/1 "Cormorant Garamond",serif;color:rgba(154,116,50,.35)}
.pk{font-family:Cinzel,serif;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--gold);padding-right:60px}
.pbody h3{font-size:clamp(28px,2.6vw,38px)}
.pbody p{color:var(--mute);font-size:15px}
.tags{list-style:none;margin:6px 0 0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.tags li{font-size:13px;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:4px 12px;color:#3d3830}
.also{margin-top:56px;display:grid;gap:18px}
.alsog{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:1px;background:var(--line);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.alsog div{background:var(--bg);padding:24px}
.alsog h3{font-size:26px;margin-bottom:6px}
.alsog p{color:var(--mute);font-size:14px}
.port{margin-top:64px}
.porth{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:8px 24px;margin-bottom:20px}
.porth h3{font-size:clamp(30px,3vw,40px)}
.porth p{color:var(--mute)}
.pgal{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}
.pgal figure{margin:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:4/3;background:#f3f0ea;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.pgal img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 1.2s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.pgal figure:hover img{transform:scale(1.06)}
.pgal figcaption{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:26px 14px 10px;font-size:13px;color:#15130f;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(7,6,5,.85))}
/* approach */
.steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:1px;background:var(--line);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.step{background:var(--bg);padding:32px 26px;display:grid;gap:14px;align-content:start}
.step .w{font:italic 500 clamp(36px,3.4vw,50px)/1 "Cormorant Garamond",serif;color:var(--gold)}
.step p{color:var(--mute);font-size:15px}
/* team */
.teamb{background:var(--panel)}
.team{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.2fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(28px,5vw,72px)}
.person{display:grid;grid-template-columns:104px minmax(0,1fr);gap:24px;padding:30px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.person:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.av{width:104px;height:104px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--gold);display:grid;place-items:center;font:500 32px/1 Cinzel,serif;color:var(--gold)}
.av.photo{object-fit:cover;padding:3px;background:var(--bg);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--gold)}
.person h3{font-size:32px}
.role{font-family:Cinzel,serif;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--gold);margin:6px 0 12px}
.person p{color:var(--mute);font-size:15px}
.why{border:1px solid var(--line);padding:clamp(26px,3vw,40px);align-self:start}
.why h3{font-size:34px;margin-bottom:22px}
.why ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:14px}
.why li{position:relative;padding-left:26px;color:#3d3830;font-size:15px;line-height:1.5}
.why li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:2px;top:.55em;width:9px;height:9px;transform:rotate(45deg);background:var(--gold)}
.why .pos{margin-top:24px;padding-top:20px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font:italic 500 22px/1.3 "Cormorant Garamond",serif;color:var(--ink)}
/* faq */
.faq{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:0 56px}
.qa{padding:26px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.qa h3{font-size:26px;margin-bottom:8px}
.qa p{color:var(--mute);font-size:15px}
/* contact */
.contact{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.cgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.1fr);gap:clamp(32px,5vw,80px)}
.cside{display:grid;gap:26px;align-content:start}
.cside h2{font-size:clamp(48px,6vw,88px);line-height:.96}
.phone{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;text-decoration:none;padding:18px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.phone:last-of-type{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.phone svg{width:24px;height:24px;color:var(--gold);flex:none}
.phone b{font:500 34px/1 "Cormorant Garamond",serif;white-space:nowrap}
.phone:hover b{color:var(--gold)}
.loc{color:var(--mute)}
form{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:clamp(22px,3vw,40px);align-content:start}
.f{display:grid;gap:8px}
.f.full{grid-column:1/-1}
label{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--gold)}
input,select,textarea{font:16px/1.4 Jost,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:0;padding:13px 14px;min-height:50px;width:100%}
select option{background:var(--bg)}
textarea{min-height:140px;resize:vertical}
input::placeholder,textarea::placeholder{color:#6f675b}
.err{font-size:14px;color:#ff9b8a}
.done{grid-column:1/-1;display:none;gap:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:20px}
.done.on{display:grid}
.done pre{margin:0;white-space:pre-wrap;font:14px/1.6 Jost,sans-serif;color:var(--mute);overflow-wrap:anywhere}
/* footer */
footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
footer .flogo{width:min(560px,100%);margin:0 auto}
footer nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:4px 26px;margin:34px 0}
footer nav a{text-decoration:none;color:var(--mute);letter-spacing:.04em}
footer nav a:hover{color:var(--gold)}
footer small{display:block;font-size:13px;color:#7d7466;padding-top:22px;border-top:1px solid var(--line2)}
@media(max-width:1100px){.links a.x{display:none}.lod{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:900px){.pg{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.pcard.wide{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.pcard.wide .pimg{min-height:0;aspect-ratio:16/10}.alsog{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.pgal{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.head,.intro,.feat,.team,.cgrid,.faq{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.sgrid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.steps{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.stats div:nth-child(3){border-left:0;padding-left:0}.stats div:nth-child(n+3){border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.pside{position:static}.feat img{min-height:320px;height:360px}.gal{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.gal img{height:360px}.gal img:nth-child(2){grid-column:1/-1;order:-1}}
@media(max-width:640px){.links,.brand span{display:none}.nav .btn{margin-left:auto;padding:0 12px;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.02em}.brand img{height:44px}.hero{min-height:0;padding:72px 16px 96px}.leaders{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch}.introb .btn{width:100%}.introb .cta{flex-direction:column}.ticks,.svc .ticks{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.lod{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.steps{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}form{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.frame img{height:380px}.person{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.phone b{font-size:30px}.gal img{height:260px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}.btn{transition:none}}

/* topbar */
.topbar{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line2);background:#000}
.tb{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;padding:6px max(5vw,16px);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;font-size:13px;color:var(--mute)}
.tbr{display:flex;gap:18px}
.tbr a{text-decoration:none;color:var(--gold)}
/* who */
.whob{background:var(--panel)}
.wgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:1px;background:var(--line);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.wt{background:var(--panel);padding:30px;text-decoration:none;display:grid;gap:10px;align-content:start;transition:background .4s}
.wt:hover{background:#1d1a15}
.wt svg{width:40px;height:40px;fill:none;stroke:var(--gold);stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linejoin:round}
.wt h3{font-size:28px}
.wt p{color:var(--mute);font-size:15px}
/* filters */
.pfil{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:-24px 0 28px}
.pfil button{font:500 14px Jost,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.03em;min-height:44px;padding:0 18px;background:transparent;color:var(--mute);border:1px solid var(--line);cursor:pointer}
.pfil button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold);color:#ffffff}
.pcard[hidden]{display:none}
/* reveal */
.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:opacity .9s ease,transform .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
/* footer */
.fgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:36px;text-align:left;margin-bottom:40px}
.fbrand .flogo{width:min(320px,100%);margin:0}
.fbrand p{color:var(--mute);font-size:14px;margin-top:14px;max-width:34ch}
.fgrid h4{font:500 13px Cinzel,serif;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--gold);margin:0 0 14px}
.fgrid a,.fgrid span{display:block;color:var(--mute);text-decoration:none;font-size:15px;padding:5px 0}
.fgrid a:hover{color:var(--gold)}
.fcall{display:none;position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:18px;z-index:20;width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);color:#ffffff;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.fcall svg{width:26px;height:26px}
.fcall{transition:opacity .25s ease,transform .25s ease}.fcall.away{opacity:0;transform:scale(.6);pointer-events:none}
@media(max-width:900px){.wgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.fgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.fbrand{grid-column:1/-1}.fcall{display:grid}}
@media(max-width:640px){.tbl{display:none}.tb{justify-content:center}.wgrid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.pfil{margin-top:-20px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.rv{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:none}}

/* insights */
.insb{background:var(--panel)}
.igrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px;align-items:start}
.art{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg)}
.art summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;padding:28px;display:grid;gap:12px}
.art summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.ak{font:500 12px Cinzel,serif;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--gold)}
.art h3{font-size:28px}
.art summary p{color:var(--mute);font-size:15px}
.more{color:var(--gold);font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.04em}
.more::after{content:" +"}
.art[open] .more::after{content:" −"}
.art[open]{border-color:rgba(154,116,50,.6)}
.abody{padding:0 28px 28px;border-top:1px solid var(--line2);display:grid;gap:12px}
.abody p,.abody li{color:#3d3830;font-size:15px;line-height:1.6}
.abody p:first-child{margin-top:18px}
.abody ul{margin:0;padding-left:18px;display:grid;gap:8px}
.abody b{color:var(--gold);font-weight:500}
@media(max-width:900px){.igrid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}}
.btn{color:#fff}.btn:hover{background:#b08640}.btn.ghost{color:var(--gold)}
.topbar{background:#15130f}.topbar .tb{color:#cfc8bc}.tbr a{color:#e8c172}
header{background:rgba(247,245,241,.95)}
.hero{color:#f4efe6}.hero h1{color:#f4efe6}.hero .script{color:#e8c172}
.feat,.lodb{background:#15130f;color:#f4efe6}.feat .lead,.lodb .lead,.lodb .lv p{color:#c9c1b3}.feat .ticks li{color:#e2dbcf}.feat em,.lodb em,.feat .kick,.lodb .kick{color:#e8c172}.lodb .lv{background:#15130f}.lodb .lod{background:rgba(232,193,114,.25);border-color:rgba(232,193,114,.25)}.lodb .lv b{color:#e8c172}.lodb .lv .use{color:#e2dbcf}.lg,.lc{stroke:#e8c172}.lf{fill:#e8c172}.lm{stroke:#e8c172}.lb{fill:#15130f}
footer{background:#15130f;color:#f4efe6}footer .fgrid a,footer .fgrid span,footer .fbrand p{color:#c9c1b3}footer h4{color:#e8c172}footer small{color:#9a9285}
.pgal figcaption{color:#fff}
.fcall{color:#fff}.intro.solo{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);max-width:900px;text-align:center}.intro.solo .lead{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
.feat>img.rv-img{object-fit:cover;background:#f3f0ea}

/* discipline accordion */
.discs{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.disc{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.disc summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:grid;grid-template-columns:56px minmax(0,1fr) auto 44px;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:24px 8px;transition:background .3s}
.disc summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.disc summary:hover{background:var(--panel2)}
.disc summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:-2px}
.dn{font:500 30px/1 "Cormorant Garamond",serif;color:var(--gold)}
.dt b{display:block;font:500 clamp(24px,2.4vw,32px)/1.1 "Cormorant Garamond",serif}
.dt small{display:block;color:var(--mute);font-size:15px;margin-top:4px}
.dc{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--gold);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:5px 12px;white-space:nowrap}
.dp{width:44px;height:44px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:50%;position:relative;transition:transform .4s,background .3s}
.dp::before,.dp::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:14px;height:1.5px;background:var(--gold);transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
.dp::after{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(90deg);transition:transform .4s}
.disc[open] .dp{background:var(--gold);transform:rotate(180deg)}
.disc[open] .dp::before,.disc[open] .dp::after{background:var(--panel)}
.disc[open] .dp::after{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(0)}
.disc[open] summary{background:var(--panel2)}
.sub{padding:8px 8px 30px 82px;background:var(--panel2);animation:subin .45s ease both}
@keyframes subin{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.subl{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
.subl li{position:relative;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:12px 14px 12px 34px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.4;color:var(--ink)}
.subl li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:14px;top:1.15em;width:8px;height:8px;transform:rotate(45deg);border:1px solid var(--gold)}
.sublink{display:inline-block;margin-top:18px;color:var(--gold);font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.04em;text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.sublink:hover{border-color:var(--gold)}
@media(max-width:900px){.subl{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.sub{padding-left:8px}}
@media(max-width:640px){.disc summary{grid-template-columns:40px minmax(0,1fr) 44px;gap:12px}.dc{display:none}.dn{font-size:24px}.subl{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.sub{animation:none}.dp,.dp::after{transition:none}}

/* interiors feature accordion (dark panel) */
.feat .fdiscs{--ink:#f4efe6;--mute:#c9c1b3;--line:rgba(232,193,114,.28);--panel:#15130f;--panel2:#1f1c17;--gold:#e8c172;border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin:4px 0 6px}
.feat .fdiscs .disc summary{grid-template-columns:44px minmax(0,1fr) auto 40px;padding:18px 6px;gap:14px}
.feat .fdiscs .dt b{font-size:clamp(22px,2vw,28px);color:var(--ink)}
.feat .fdiscs .dp{width:40px;height:40px}
.feat .fdiscs .sub{padding:4px 6px 22px 64px}
.feat .fdiscs .subl{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
.feat .fdiscs .subl li{background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink)}
@media(max-width:640px){.feat .fdiscs .disc summary{grid-template-columns:34px minmax(0,1fr) 40px}.feat .fdiscs .sub{padding-left:6px}.feat .fdiscs .subl{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}}
.dnote{color:var(--mute);font-size:14px;padding:14px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);margin:0}.dnote a{color:var(--gold)}
.infeat{margin-bottom:28px;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.infeat>img{min-height:520px}
@media(max-width:900px){.infeat>img{min-height:0}}

/* discipline marquee */
.ribbon{display:block;overflow:hidden;padding:26px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);-webkit-mask:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 6%,#000 94%,transparent);mask:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 6%,#000 94%,transparent)}
.rtrack{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:marq 48s linear infinite}
.ribbon:hover .rtrack,.ribbon:focus-within .rtrack{animation-play-state:paused}
.rt{display:flex;align-items:center;flex:none}
.rt a{font:italic 500 clamp(24px,2.4vw,34px)/1.2 "Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;padding:4px 26px;white-space:nowrap;transition:color .3s}
.rt a:hover,.rt a:focus-visible{color:var(--gold)}
.rt i{color:var(--gold);font-style:normal;font-size:12px}
@keyframes marq{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.rtrack{animation:none;width:auto;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}.rt[aria-hidden]{display:none}.rt{flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}.ribbon{-webkit-mask:none;mask:none}}

/* ===== 3D project carousel ===== */
.c3wrap{margin-top:8px}
.c3{overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scrollbar-width:none;cursor:grab;padding:30px 0 10px;-webkit-mask:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 4%,#000 96%,transparent);mask:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 4%,#000 96%,transparent)}
.c3::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.c3.drag{cursor:grabbing;scroll-snap-type:none}
.c3t{display:flex;width:max-content;padding:0 6vw}
.slot{--s:clamp(190px,22vw,290px);--d:14px;flex:none;width:calc(var(--s)*1.02);margin-right:calc(var(--s)*-.02);perspective:1300px;perspective-origin:50% 20%;scroll-snap-align:center;display:grid;justify-items:center;gap:6px}
.slot[hidden]{display:none}
.card3{all:unset;cursor:pointer;position:relative;width:var(--s);height:var(--s);transform-style:preserve-3d;transform:rotateX(56deg) rotateZ(-40deg);transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);margin:calc(var(--s)*-.16) 0 calc(var(--s)*-.04)}
.card3:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:6px}
.slot:hover .card3,.card3:focus-visible{transform:rotateX(50deg) rotateZ(-40deg) translateZ(34px)}
.card3 .fc{position:absolute;inset:0;transform:translateZ(var(--d));background:#f3f0ea;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.06)}
.card3 .fc img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.card3 .fc.ct img{object-fit:contain;background:#fff;padding:6%}
.card3 .er{position:absolute;top:0;left:100%;width:var(--d);height:100%;transform-origin:0 50%;transform:rotateY(-90deg);background:linear-gradient(90deg,#b9b1a3,#d8d1c4)}
.card3 .eb{position:absolute;left:0;top:100%;height:var(--d);width:100%;transform-origin:50% 0;transform:rotateX(90deg);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#a79f91,#cbc4b7)}
.alsog{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
@media(max-width:900px){.alsog{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}}
.card3 .sh{position:absolute;inset:6%;transform:translateZ(0);background:rgba(20,16,10,.22);filter:blur(14px);transition:inset .7s}
.slot:hover .card3 .sh{inset:12%}
.cap3{position:relative;z-index:2;font-size:13px;color:var(--mute);text-align:center;max-width:var(--s);line-height:1.35}
.cap3 b{display:block;font:italic 500 22px/1.1 "Cormorant Garamond",serif;color:var(--ink)}
@media(max-width:1100px){.cap3 b{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;min-height:2.2em;text-wrap:balance}}
.c3nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:18px}
.c3b{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink);font-size:18px;cursor:pointer}
.c3b:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold)}
.c3hint{color:var(--mute);font-size:13px;margin-left:6px}
/* fly animation */
.fly{position:fixed;z-index:60;pointer-events:none;transform-style:preserve-3d;margin:0}
.fly img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
/* modal */
.pm{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:50;background:var(--bg);display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.pm[hidden]{display:none}
.pmbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:10px max(5vw,16px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg)}
.pmk{font:500 11.5px Jost,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold)}
.pmx{min-height:44px;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink);font:500 14px Jost,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}
.pmx:hover{border-color:var(--ink)}
.pms{overflow-y:auto;flex:1;overscroll-behavior:contain}
.pmh{margin:0;position:relative;background:#f3f0ea}
.pmh>img{width:100%;height:min(66vh,680px);object-fit:cover;display:block;background:#fff}
.pmh>img.ct{object-fit:contain}
.pmg{margin:0;padding:clamp(20px,3vw,40px) max(5vw,16px) 0;background:var(--bg)}
.pmg[hidden]{display:none}
.pmg>img{width:100%;max-width:1100px;height:auto;margin:0 auto;display:block;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px}
.pmg figcaption{max-width:1100px;margin:10px auto 0;font-size:14px;color:var(--mute);text-align:center}
.pmth{position:absolute;left:max(5vw,16px);bottom:16px;display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.pmth button{width:64px;height:44px;padding:0;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);background:#fff;cursor:pointer;overflow:hidden;opacity:.85}
.pmth button[aria-pressed=true]{border-color:var(--gold);opacity:1}
.pmth img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.pmb{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:clamp(28px,4vw,56px) max(5vw,16px)}
.pmb h2{font:italic 500 clamp(44px,6vw,84px)/1 "Cormorant Garamond",serif}
.pmtags{list-style:none;margin:18px 0 0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.pmtags li{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);padding:6px 14px;border-radius:999px;font-size:14px}
.pmd{margin-top:22px;font-size:18px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--ink);max-width:62ch}
.pmspec{margin:28px 0 0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:0 48px;max-width:760px}
.pmspec div{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.pmspec dt{color:var(--mute);font-size:14px}
.pmspec dd{margin:0;text-align:right;font-size:15px}
.pmsoon{margin-top:14px;font-size:14px;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.04em}
.pmenq{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:30px;min-height:52px;padding:0 26px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500}
.pmenq:hover{background:var(--gold)}
.pmrel{background:var(--panel2);padding:clamp(28px,4vw,48px) 0 clamp(36px,5vw,64px)}
.pmrel .kick{padding:0 max(5vw,16px)}
.c3s .slot{--s:clamp(150px,16vw,210px)}
.pmb>*{animation:pmin .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both}
@keyframes pmin{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
body.pmopen{overflow:hidden}
.infeat{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
.infeat .txt{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.85fr) minmax(0,1.15fr);column-gap:clamp(32px,5vw,80px);align-items:start}
.infeat .txt>.discs{grid-column:2;grid-row:1/span 3}
@media(max-width:900px){.infeat .txt{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.infeat .txt>.discs{grid-column:auto;grid-row:auto}}
@media(max-width:640px){.pmspec{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.pmh>img{height:52vh}.c3hint{display:none}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.card3,.card3 .sh{transition:none}.pmb>*{animation:none}}

/* ===== BIM automation ===== */
.autog{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(28px,4vw,64px);align-items:start;margin-top:8px}
.autoc{display:grid;gap:0}
.auto{display:grid;grid-template-columns:52px minmax(0,1fr);gap:4px 14px;padding:22px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.auto .an{grid-row:1/span 2;font:500 26px/1 "Cormorant Garamond",serif;color:var(--gold)}
.auto h3{font:500 26px/1.15 "Cormorant Garamond",serif;margin:0}
.auto p{margin:0;color:var(--mute);line-height:1.6}
.autol{list-style:none;margin:8px 0 0;padding:22px 0 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.autol li{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);padding:7px 14px;border-radius:999px;font-size:14px}
.autob{justify-self:start;margin-top:26px}
.code{margin:0;background:#15130f;color:#e9e2d4;border:1px solid rgba(232,193,114,.25);box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(21,19,15,.18);position:sticky;top:110px}
.cbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(232,193,114,.18)}
.cbar i{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(232,193,114,.35)}
.cbar span{margin-left:8px;font:500 12px Jost,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#e8c172}
.code pre{margin:0;padding:22px 20px 26px;overflow-x:auto;font:13.5px/1.75 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace}
.ck{color:#e8c172}.cs{color:#b9d4a3}.cc{color:#8f877a;font-style:italic}
@media(max-width:900px){.autog{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.code{position:static}.code pre{font-size:12px}}

/* ===== Script store ===== */
.shopb{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:0 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink);font:500 14px Jost,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;flex:none}
.shopb svg{width:20px;height:20px;color:var(--gold)}
.shopb:hover{border-color:var(--gold)}
.substore{list-style:none}
.substore button{all:unset;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--gold);color:var(--gold2);font-weight:500}
.substore svg{width:18px;height:18px;flex:none}
.substore button:hover,.substore button:focus-visible{background:var(--gold);color:#fff}
.autobs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:26px}
.autobs .autob{margin:0}
.btn svg{width:20px;height:20px}
.st{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:55;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:24px}
.st[hidden]{display:none}
.stbg{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(21,19,15,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(4px);animation:stfade .35s both}
.stp{position:relative;width:min(1040px,100%);max-height:calc(100vh - 48px);overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 40px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.35);padding:clamp(22px,3.5vw,44px);animation:stin .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both}
@keyframes stfade{from{opacity:0}}
@keyframes stin{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px) scale(.97)}}
.sth{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:18px}
.sth h2{font:500 clamp(34px,4.5vw,56px)/1.02 "Cormorant Garamond",serif;margin:6px 0 0}
.sth h2 em{color:var(--gold)}
.stl{margin:12px 0 0;color:var(--mute);max-width:56ch;line-height:1.6}
.stf{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:24px 0 18px}
.stf button{min-height:40px;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink);font:500 14px Jost,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}
.stf button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold);color:#fff}
.stg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
.sc{display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);transition:border-color .2s,transform .3s}
.sc:hover{border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-3px)}
.sc[hidden]{display:none}
.sci{position:relative;aspect-ratio:16/9;background:#15130f;color:#e8c172;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden}
.sci svg{width:46%;height:70%;opacity:.95}
.scp{position:absolute;left:12px;top:12px;font:500 11px Jost,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;border:1px solid rgba(232,193,114,.45);padding:4px 9px}
.scb{padding:16px 18px 18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;flex:1}
.scb h3{font:500 24px/1.1 "Cormorant Garamond",serif;margin:0}
.scb p{margin:0;color:var(--mute);font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.55;flex:1}
.scr{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-top:8px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.scr span{font-size:14px;color:var(--gold2);font-weight:500}
.scr button{min-height:42px;padding:0 16px;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border:0;font:500 14px Jost,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.scr button:hover{background:var(--gold)}
.scr svg{width:17px;height:17px}
.stn{margin:22px 0 0;color:var(--mute);font-size:14.5px}
.stn a{color:var(--gold2);font-weight:500}
body.stopen{overflow:hidden}
.stl b{color:var(--gold2)}

/* why dynamo video */
.dwhy{margin:22px 0 0;padding:20px 0 4px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.dwhy.whym{margin-top:clamp(36px,5vw,64px);padding-bottom:0}.whym .whyv{width:min(560px,100%)}
.dwhy h3{font:500 clamp(26px,3vw,36px)/1.1 "Cormorant Garamond",serif;margin:0 0 6px}
.dwhy h3 em{color:var(--gold)}
.dwhy p{margin:0 0 14px;color:var(--mute);font-size:15px;max-width:60ch}
.whyv{position:relative;display:block;width:min(420px,100%);padding:0;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#000;cursor:pointer;aspect-ratio:16/9;overflow:hidden}
.whyv img,.whyv video{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;pointer-events:none}
.whym{margin-top:clamp(36px,5vw,64px);padding-top:clamp(28px,4vw,48px)}
.whym .whyv{width:min(560px,100%)}
.whyv .pl{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(0,0,0,.28);transition:background .2s}
.whyv:hover .pl{background:rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
.whyv .pl i{width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);display:grid;place-items:center}
.whyv .pl i::after{content:"";margin-left:5px;border-left:16px solid #fff;border-top:10px solid transparent;border-bottom:10px solid transparent}
.whyv:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:3px}
.wzo{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:80;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:16px;background:rgba(5,4,3,.9);opacity:0;transition:opacity .35s ease}
.wzo[hidden]{display:none}
.wzo.on{opacity:1}
.wzo video{width:min(1100px,100%);max-height:86vh;background:#000;cursor:pointer;transform:scale(.6);transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.wzo.on video{transform:scale(1)}
.wzo small{position:absolute;bottom:14px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.04em}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.wzo,.wzo video{transition:none}}
.stbar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin:24px 0 8px;position:sticky;top:calc(-1*clamp(22px,3.5vw,44px));background:var(--bg);padding:10px 0;z-index:2;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.stbar .stf{margin:0}
.sqw{flex:1 1 240px;max-width:340px}
.sqw input{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;min-height:42px;padding:0 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel);font:15px Jost,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)}
.sqw input:focus{outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:1px}
.sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0)}
.stg{display:block}
.sgp{margin-top:26px}
.sgp[hidden]{display:none}
.sgh{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-bottom:12px;margin-bottom:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.sgh>div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;column-gap:14px;align-items:center}
.sgk{grid-row:1/span 2;width:48px;height:48px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#15130f;color:#e8c172;font:500 26px "Cormorant Garamond",serif}
.sgh h3{font:500 26px/1.1 "Cormorant Garamond",serif;margin:0}
.sgh small{color:var(--mute);font-size:13.5px}
.sgb{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:42px;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid var(--gold);background:transparent;color:var(--gold2);font:500 14px Jost,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}
.sgb:hover{background:var(--gold);color:#fff}
.sgb svg{width:17px;height:17px}
.sgl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
.sc:hover{transform:none}
.sct{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px}
.scc{font:600 13px Jost,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#fff;background:var(--gold);padding:3px 8px;flex:none}
.sct h3{font-size:22px}
.scf{display:block;font:11.5px/1.4 ui-monospace,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;color:var(--mute);overflow-wrap:anywhere;opacity:.85}
.sctg{font-size:12.5px!important;color:var(--mute)!important;font-weight:400!important}
.scb p{flex:none}
.scb{gap:7px;padding:14px 16px 14px}
.scr{margin-top:auto}
.sempty{margin:30px 0;color:var(--mute)}
@media(max-width:760px){.stbar .stf{flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;width:100%}.stf button{flex:none}.sgl{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.sqw{max-width:none}.stbar{top:-22px}}
.pmx{white-space:nowrap}
.subl li.substore{grid-column:1/-1;border:0;padding:0;background:none}
.subl li.substore::before{display:none}
.substore button{justify-content:flex-start;padding:12px 16px;background:var(--panel)}
.nav .btn .pm2{display:none}
.nav .btn{flex:none}
.links{min-width:0;padding-left:10px}
@media(max-width:1500px){.brand img{height:48px}.shopb span{display:none}.shopb{width:44px;padding:0;justify-content:center}.nav{gap:18px}}
@media(max-width:640px){.nav{gap:10px}.brand img{height:34px}.shopb{margin-left:auto;width:42px;min-height:42px}.nav .btn.ghost{margin-left:0;padding:0 12px}.nav .btn .pv{display:none}.nav .btn .pm2{display:inline}}
@media(max-width:900px){.stg{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:640px){.st{padding:0;place-items:end stretch}.stp{max-height:92vh;border-left:0;border-right:0;border-bottom:0}.stg{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.shopb span{display:none}.shopb{padding:0 11px}@keyframes stin{from{transform:translateY(100%)}}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.stp,.stbg{animation:none}}

/* ===== LOD viewer ===== */
.lx{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.5fr) minmax(0,1fr);grid-template-areas:"stage det" "tabs det";gap:18px clamp(24px,3.5vw,56px);margin-top:10px}
.lxs{grid-area:stage;position:relative;aspect-ratio:16/9;overflow:hidden;background:#e9e8e6;border:1px solid rgba(232,193,114,.25);touch-action:pan-y;user-select:none}
.lxi{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;opacity:0;transform:scale(1.04);transition:opacity .9s ease,transform 1.4s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.lxi.on{opacity:1;transform:none}
.lxchip{position:absolute;left:14px;top:14px;background:rgba(21,19,15,.86);color:#e8c172;font:500 12px Jost,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:8px 12px}
.lxn{position:absolute;right:14px;bottom:12px;font:500 13px Jost,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#15130f;background:rgba(255,255,255,.8);padding:5px 10px}
.lxa{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:rgba(21,19,15,.78);color:#e8c172;font-size:18px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s}
.lxa:hover{background:#15130f}
.lxa:disabled{opacity:.25;cursor:default}
.lxp{left:12px}.lxnx{right:12px}
.lxt{grid-area:tabs;position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px;padding-top:14px}
.lxbar{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:2px;background:rgba(232,193,114,.2)}
.lxbar i{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:20%;background:#e8c172;transition:width .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.lxt button{all:unset;cursor:pointer;display:grid;gap:2px;padding:10px 10px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(232,193,114,.18);color:#c9c1b3;transition:border-color .25s,background .25s,color .25s}
.lxt button b{font:500 clamp(24px,2.4vw,34px)/1 "Cormorant Garamond",serif;color:#f4efe6}
.lxt button small{font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.3}
.lxt button[aria-selected=true]{border-color:#e8c172;background:rgba(232,193,114,.1);color:#e8c172}
.lxt button[aria-selected=true] b{color:#e8c172}
.lxt button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #e8c172;outline-offset:2px}
.lxd{grid-area:det;align-self:start;border-top:1px solid rgba(232,193,114,.3);padding-top:18px}
.lxd>*{animation:lxin .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both}
.lxd>*:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.05s}.lxd>*:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.1s}.lxd>*:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.15s}.lxd>*:nth-child(5){animation-delay:.2s}
@keyframes lxin{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px)}}
.lxk{font:500 12px Jost,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#e8c172;margin:0}
.lxd h3{font:500 clamp(40px,4.6vw,64px)/1 "Cormorant Garamond",serif;color:#f4efe6;margin:8px 0 2px}
.lxd h3 em{font-style:italic;color:#e8c172}
.lxst{color:#c9c1b3;margin:0 0 8px}
.lxr{border-top:1px solid rgba(232,193,114,.18);padding:14px 0}
.lxr h4{font:500 12px Jost,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#a89f8f;margin:0 0 6px}
.lxr p{margin:0;color:#e2dbcf;line-height:1.6;font-size:15.5px}
.lxu{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px}
.lxu li{border:1px solid rgba(232,193,114,.35);color:#f4efe6;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:999px;font-size:13.5px}
@media(max-width:980px){.lx{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);grid-template-areas:"stage" "tabs" "det"}}
@media(max-width:640px){.lxt{gap:4px}.lxt button{padding:8px 6px 10px;text-align:center}.lxt button small{display:none}.lxa{width:40px;height:40px}.lxchip{font-size:10.5px;padding:6px 9px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.lxi,.lxbar i{transition:none}.lxd>*{animation:none}}

/* ===== Hero video ===== */
.hero.hvid{--hbg:#d7d7d4;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 60% at 50% 62%,#dcdcd9,var(--hbg) 70%);color:var(--ink);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;padding:clamp(26px,3.5vw,48px) max(5vw,16px) 0;min-height:min(calc(100svh - 108px),920px)}
.hero.hvid::after{display:none}
.hvid .hc{gap:14px}
.hvid .lw{width:min(600px,82vw)}
.hvid .hlogo{width:100%;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 3px rgba(60,40,10,.35)) drop-shadow(0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18))}
.hvid h1{color:#15130f;text-shadow:none;font-size:clamp(30px,3.6vw,54px)}
.hvid .script{color:#8a6424}
.hvw{position:relative;flex:1 1 auto;width:100%;min-height:320px;margin-top:-34px;overflow:hidden}
.hv{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;object-position:center bottom;-webkit-mask:radial-gradient(ellipse 52% 54% at 50% 52%,#000 72%,transparent 100%);mask:radial-gradient(ellipse 52% 54% at 50% 52%,#000 72%,transparent 100%);transition:opacity .8s ease}
.hv.fade{opacity:0}
.hlod{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:18px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:3;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;background:rgba(21,19,15,.82);padding:6px 8px;font:500 12px Jost,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.12em}
.hlk{color:#a89f8f;padding:0 6px 0 4px}
.hlt{color:#8f877a;padding:4px 8px;transition:color .4s,background .4s}
.hlt.on{color:#15130f;background:#e8c172}
.hpp{position:absolute;right:max(5vw,16px);bottom:14px;z-index:3;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(21,19,15,.25);background:rgba(255,255,255,.7);cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center}
.hpp:hover{background:#fff}
.hpp .ip{width:12px;height:14px;border-left:4px solid #15130f;border-right:4px solid #15130f;box-sizing:border-box}
.hpp[aria-pressed=true] .ip{width:0;height:0;border-left:13px solid #15130f;border-right:0;border-top:8px solid transparent;border-bottom:8px solid transparent;margin-left:4px}
@media(max-width:640px){.hero.hvid{min-height:0;padding:30px 16px 0}.hvid .lw{width:88vw}.hvid h1{font-size:30px}.hvw{flex:none;height:300px;min-height:0;margin-top:-6px}.hv{left:50%;top:auto;bottom:0;width:165%;max-width:none;height:auto;transform:translateX(-50%);inset:auto auto 0 50%}.hlod{bottom:12px;font-size:11px}.hlt{padding:3px 6px}.hpp{width:40px;height:40px;bottom:8px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.hv{transition:none}}
/* black logo area fading into the video */
.hvid .hc{position:relative;padding-bottom:6px}
.hvid .hc::before{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:-1;left:50%;width:100vw;transform:translateX(-50%);top:calc(-1*clamp(26px,3.5vw,48px));bottom:-110px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0b0a08 0%,#0b0a08 calc(100% - 150px),rgba(11,10,8,.82) calc(100% - 95px),rgba(11,10,8,.35) calc(100% - 45px),rgba(11,10,8,0) 100%);pointer-events:none}
.hvid h1{color:#f4efe6;text-shadow:0 2px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.hvid .script{color:#e8c172}
.hvid .hlogo{filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.5))}
.hvid .hvw{margin-top:-20px}
@media(max-width:640px){.hvid .hc::before{top:-30px;bottom:-80px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0b0a08 0%,#0b0a08 calc(100% - 110px),rgba(11,10,8,.7) calc(100% - 65px),rgba(11,10,8,0) 100%)}.hvid .hvw{margin-top:0}}

/* header without logo image */
.brand span{font-size:15px}
@media(max-width:640px){.brand span{display:block;font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.08em}.brand small{font-size:10px}}
/* ===== gold logo shine + stars ===== */
.hvid .lw{position:relative}
.lshine{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;-webkit-mask:url(data:image/png;base64,) center/100% 100% no-repeat;mask:url(data:image/png;base64,
